the coach tick refuses an untokened call (rejected probe, no write)

tests.reason: This change only sets production environment values and adds one scheduler job; staging must keep the coach off (it shares the production database), which the status probe proves. The workflow pins, the absence of VOA_MODE, the staging workflow staying clean, the single daily tick job and that the pinned values resolve to shadow (and to disabled-on-staging on staging) are proven in vtid-05039; the coach's shadow-only behaviour itself stays proven in vtid-04892.
